results.name: user_multi_profiles
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE `user_multi_profiles` (
  `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `user_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `name` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `avatar` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_child_profile` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_by` INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_by` INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL
)

results.name: users
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `username` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_name` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_name` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `mobile` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_type` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_url` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `gender` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_of_birth` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_verified_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `is_banned` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_subscribe` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `country_code` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `last_notification_seen` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `address` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_type` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `pin` INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  `otp` INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_parental_lock_enable` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `remember_token` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL
, legacy_status INTEGER, migration_disabled_reason TEXT)
